meta.title: Hairdresser and barber in central Amiens | L'Atelier Caron, rue Jean Calvin
meta.description: Hairdresser and barber in central Amiens since 2016: women's cuts, fades, straight-razor beards, balayage, colour. Clear prices, booking on Planity.
meta.ogAlt: A wavy blonde balayage and a textured fade done at L'Atelier Caron, Amiens

hero.title: Cuts, colour and beards, done with care
hero.lead: Quentin looks after the men and the beards, Zoé after women's cuts and colour. A small salon on rue Jean Calvin where nobody is rushed.

team.title: Two pairs of hands, two specialities
team.lead: It's a small salon: you know who will do your hair, and you choose when you book.

quentin.name: Quentin
quentin.text: He opened the salon in 2016. Gradual fades down to the skin, scissor cuts, and beards trimmed with a straight razor and a hot towel: he looks after the men.
quentin.alt: Quentin trimming a client's beard with comb and scissors

zoe.name: Zoé
zoe.text: Trained in the salon by Quentin, Zoé looks after the women: cuts, blow-dries, updos, and above all colour. Her balayages and cool blondes fill the salon's Instagram.
zoe.alt: Zoé styling a client with short curly hair

ba.title: Balayage, fades, cuts: the transformations
ba.lead: Drag the handle. Every photo was taken in the salon, on real clients.

ritual.title: Beards, by straight razor and hot towel
ritual.text: The cut first, then the beard: trimmed, shaped, and the lines finished with a straight razor. The hot towel and the beard care are part of it, and so is the styling. Allow 45 minutes for cut and beard, 30 for a long beard on its own.
ritual.alt: Quentin trimming a client's beard in the salon

gift.title: Give a cut, a beard or a colour
gift.text: Gift cards for men and women, prepared in the salon. Tell us the service or the amount and we'll have it ready when you come to collect it.

items.a: Cash or cheque only. The salon does not take cards, so plan ahead. You pay in the salon, after your appointment.

items.q: I'm running late, or I need to cancel
items.a: Let us know as soon as you can on 03 22 40 53 07, or cancel directly on Planity. If you're very late we'll do our best, but we may need to shorten or move your appointment so the next client isn't kept waiting.
Yes, from the very youngest: €12 for under-twos, €15 to €20 for boys and €20 to €30 for girls up to 15, depending on age and length.

items.q: How do I get an exact price for colour?
items.a: Colour and balayage prices depend on length, thickness and your starting colour. The ranges are listed above. For bleach or a big change, call us or send a photo of your hair through the form, and we'll give you a price before the appointment.

items.q: Can I choose who does my hair?
items.a: Yes. On Planity, pick Quentin or Zoé when you book. Quentin mostly looks after men and beards, Zoé after women and colour.
Yes, wedding updos with a trial beforehand, on quote. Send us the date and an inspiration photo through the request form.

All photos show the salon and its work, as published on its Instagram account. They may not be reused without permission.

The request form sends your name, phone number, email and inspiration photo to the salon by email, only to answer your request. This data is never sold or used for anything else. Call the salon to have it deleted. Bookings are handled by Planity under its own terms.
The site sets no advertising or analytics cookies. It only remembers your language choice. The Google map only loads if you ask for it.
